name: tachyon
description: Faster than light image resizing service that runs on AWS. Super simple to set up, highly available and very performant.

issues.title: Support for colour grading using LUTs
Smart Cropping Unexpectedly Applies Rule of Thirds with no off mechanism
BUG: Requesting image that doesn't exist returns `Content-Type: json`
Accept standard argument formats for "false" attributes passed through query args
Fix deprecated option on Charp to upgrade version 0.35.3
